answer: 'Convert a Solexa quality (which can be negative) to a PHRED quality. PHRED and Solexa quality scores are both log transformations of a probality of error (high score = low probability of error). This function takes a Solexa score, transforms it back to a probability of error, and then re-expresses it as a PHRED score. This assumes the error estimates are equivalent.
